items.name: Replication Data for: Biocatalytic stereocontrolled head-to-tail cyclizations of unbiased terpenes as a tool in chemoenzymatic synthesis
items.description: This data set contains all relevant simulation input files (topologies, coordinates, simulation parameters), generated simulation output (final configurations, time series of collective variables) together with scripts used for set-up and analysis of the umbrella sampling and double decoupling simulations.
